trl_rationale: Mission design study that combines flight-proven heritage components with a newer, lower-maturity flight computer. No single technology is developed or tested, so the readiness depends on which element is assessed. If forced to rate the observatory as a whole, it would be TRL 2 (concept formulated).

evidence.quote: The design team analyzed the mission and instrument requirements, and designed a spacecraft that enables the WFXT mission while using high heritage components.
Option 1 used L3 transmitter and receiver units, which have good heritage.

review_notes: Deliberate abstention case. Alternative label: completed, TRL 2.
